Independently represented exhaustive finite algorithms confirm all stated counts to n=7, with geometric plus closure checks also at n=8.

value.rationale: Gives a polynomial-time structural characterization of every shattered query support in a classical Catalan concept class, not merely a dimension or arbitrary census. The crossed-pair phenomenon separates it from standard crossing-free forest complexes, while three-edge and minimal four-edge obstructions and nonmatroid exchange failure elucidate the true support structure. Known top-layer enumeration is credited.
